component.name: Tune
component.summary: Folder-first music player for the margo desktop

description.p: Tune plays everything in a folder. Point it at your music directory and it scans it recursively, loads every track, and keeps the queue in sync as the folder changes. It integrates with the margo shell: a bar pill, a bar menu, and a system-tray icon with transport controls, plus standard MPRIS2 so other players and remotes can drive it.
Tune is a fork of a GPL-3.0-or-later GTK music player, re-themed and extended for margo.
Initial fork: re-branded as Tune, moved into the margo workspace.
